name: Partner Portal
one_liner: Portal for vendors, agencies and partners: onboarding, documents, requests and SLAs.
fits_when: the company works with many vendors, agencies or service partners that need their own login
partners must submit contracts, tax, insurance and compliance documents before they can work
requests, queries and deliverables run between partners and an internal owner by email today
requests should be answered within agreed SLAs by type and priority
partner performance is reviewed monthly and signed off before it is shared
each partner may see only its own documents, requests and scorecards
gives_you: Partner onboarding from invite to activation, with a partner login created on invite
Document collection with verification, rejection reasons and expiry alerts
Requests with type, priority, an SLA clock that pauses while awaiting the partner, and breach flags
An SLA definition master by request type and priority with response and resolution targets
Monthly SLA scorecards prepared by the partner manager, signed off maker-checker and acknowledged by the partner
A partner 360 page with open requests, breaches, documents, scorecards and an activity timeline

catalogue.description: A partner portal for companies that work through vendors, agencies and service partners. Partner managers invite partners, who sign in to upload their contracts and compliance documents for partner ops to verify; once active, partners and their managers raise requests (invoice queries, change requests, deliverables, incidents) that run against SLAs by type and priority. Each month the partner manager prepares an SLA scorecard with any service credit, partner ops signs it off and the partner acknowledges or disputes it.

roles.name: Partner
roles.description: External login for a vendor, agency or service partner: uploads documents, raises and answers requests, and acknowledges its own SLA scorecards

roles.name: Partner manager
roles.description: Owns a portfolio of partners: invites and onboards them, resolves their requests and prepares the monthly SLA scorecard

roles.name: Partner ops
roles.description: Verifies documents, activates and suspends partners, maintains SLA definitions and signs off scorecards as the checker

workflows.name: Onboarding
workflows.description: Invite, partner login, document upload, review and activation; suspension and offboarding

workflows.name: Documents
workflows.description: Upload, verification or rejection with a reason, and nightly expiry with renewal reminders

workflows.name: Requests
workflows.description: New, in progress, awaiting partner, resolved and closed, with reopen, cancel and escalation

workflows.name: SLA tracking
workflows.description: SLA clock per request by type and priority, breach flags, and a monthly scorecard signed off maker-checker

compliance: Mandatory documents verified before a partner is activated
Document expiry tracked with reminders and automatic expiry
Row-level access: each partner sees only its own records
Maker-checker sign-off of SLA scorecards and service credits
Audit trail of every request, approval and status change
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: Partner portal for about 80 agencies and vendors that support our India commercial and medical teams: creative and media agencies, event and travel vendors, and field staffing partners. Partners onboard themselves with the MSA, NDA, GST, insurance and anti-bribery documents, which partner ops verifies; high-risk partners also need compliance due diligence. Partners raise invoice queries, change requests and deliverables against SOWs and see each request's SLA by priority. Partner managers prepare a monthly SLA scorecard with service credits, which partner ops signs off before the partner acknowledges it.
